$comment: Normative producer-body samples for the six legs of
`console-integration-contract.md` § 2.4.9.1 (Operator Overview).
WHY THIS FILE EXISTS (TASK-PC-FE-295): the composer loads each producer's
response body VERBATIM into `cards[i].data`, but the two sides were tested
against different invented shapes — the former BFF's slice test (retired —
ADR-MONO-081) seeded `Map.of("balance", 0)`
and the web test seeded `{ balance: { amount, currency } }`, while the finance
producer actually emits `{ data: [ { currency, ledger, available, held } ] }`.
Both suites were green and the operator saw «잔액 정보 없음». Three of the six
cards were broken this way at once.
So this is ONE set, consumed by BOTH sides of the console-web server:
- card renderer : tests/unit/features/operator-overview/leg-body-contract.test.tsx
- composer      : tests/unit/shared/console-composition.test.ts
+ tests/unit/dashboard-composition-routes.test.ts
A card renderer that cannot read the body below is a DEFECT, not a fixture gap.
Each `body` is the producer's 200 response, shaped from the producer's own
controller/DTO code (not from prose), with provenance in `sourceOfShape`.
TASK-PC-FE-364 (2026-10-22 UTC): the six legs were swapped one-for-one from
row counts to business figures (locked accounts · unshipped orders · draft POs ·
open reconciliation discrepancies · my approval inbox · orders to ship). Still
one call per card. `erpNotLinked` is the SAME erp producer answering for a
caller whose account is linked to no employee — `meta.actorEmployeeId` absent,
empty page — and is not a seventh leg.

iam.sourceOfShape: iam-platform admin-service AccountAdminController#search (list branch, status filter TASK-BE-475) -> AccountServiceClient.AccountSearchResponse(content, totalElements, page, size, totalPages)

wms.surfaced: RECEIVED (received, not shipped or cancelled) order count (page.totalElements)

scm.sourceOfShape: scm-platform procurement-service PurchaseOrderController#search (tenant = JWT tenant_id via ActorContext) -> ApiEnvelope.of(PageResponse<PurchaseOrderResponse>(content, page, size, totalElements, totalPages)) = { data: { ... }, meta: { timestamp } }

finance.sourceOfShape: finance-platform ledger-service ReconciliationController#listDiscrepancies -> ApiEnvelope.of(List<DiscrepancyResponse>, meta{page, size, totalElements, totalPages} + timestamp)
finance.surfaced: OPEN discrepancy count (meta.totalElements) — the card renders no amount (F5: expectedMinor/actualMinor stay minor-units strings and are never read)

erp.sourceOfShape: erp-platform approval-service ApprovalInboxController#inbox -> ApiEnvelope.ofList(List<ApprovalSummaryView>, page, size, totalElements, totalPages) = { data: [ ... ], meta: { page, size, totalElements, totalPages, timestamp, actorEmployeeId (only when linked) } }
erp.surfaced: my pending approvals (meta.totalElements), only when meta.actorEmployeeId is present

ecommerce.sourceOfShape: ecommerce order-service AdminOrderController#getOrders -> AdminOrderListResponse(content[AdminOrderSummaryItem], page, size, totalElements) — no totalPages
ecommerce.surfaced: CONFIRMED (paid, not yet shipped) order count (totalElements)

erpNotLinked.producer: GET /api/erp/approval/inbox?page=0&size=1 (caller's account linked to no employee)
erpNotLinked.sourceOfShape: ApprovalApplicationService#inbox -> ActingEmployee.forRead empty -> emptyPage + actorEmployeeId null; ApprovalInboxController#inbox puts actorEmployeeId into meta ONLY when non-null (approval-api.md § v2.4)
erpNotLinked.surfaced: the «직원 연결 없음» state — NEVER rendered as 0
